_source: Registry of selectable festival beer lists for the Mini App's owner-only festival switcher (see bot.py's load_festivals_registry, reload_beer_db, and webapp_server.py's handle_festival_list/handle_festival_switch). Add a new festival by adding an entry here - key is a stable id (used in DATA_DIR/active_festival.json), label is what the switcher UI shows, image is an optional tile picture (a file name inside webapp/festivals/, square, shown in the Mini App's switcher), file is the beer-list JSON path (same {session: [beer, ...]} shape as mbcc_beers.json) relative to the project root. zoneLabels is optional: {"Area N": "custom display name"} for festivals whose physical zones aren't called "Area N" in real life (see webapp_server.py's _zone_labels_for) - display-only, the beer data's own location values (and festival_map.py's persisted layout) always keep using the real "Area N" strings underneath.
